run_train_lora_text_to_image: run the LoRA fine-tuning script for Stable Diffusion text-to-image model on a dataset
run_parse_training_args: parse command-line arguments for LoRA text-to-image fine-tuning with pretrained model and dataset options
run_save_model_card: save a model card README with YAML metadata and example images for a LoRA fine-tuned Stable Diffusion model
run_validate_lora_checkpoint: validate and resume training from a LoRA checkpoint with gradient accumulation and progress tracking
run_generate_validation_images: generate validation images from a fine-tuned LoRA Stable Diffusion pipeline using a text prompt
